findings.source_quote: When I was converted, I had never heard the term Anabaptist.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural, commonly used Hindi rendering of "converted" to match style and readability while preserving meaning. For example: "जब मैंने प्रभु को स्वीकार किया था," or "जब मैं ईमान लाया/विश्वास में आया," instead of "जब मेरा जीर्णोद्धार हुआ,". Preserve the rest of the sentence as translated.
findings.translation_quote: जब मेरा जीर्णोद्धार हुआ, तब मैंने कभी शब्द "अनाबाप्टिस्ट" नहीं सुना था।
